name: prism-workspace-agent
description: Prism Workspace Agent — system tray application for connecting local workspaces to Prism

scripts.copy-assets: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const copyDir = (src, dest) => { fs.mkdirSync(dest, { recursive: true }); fs.readdirSync(src).forEach(file => { if (file.endsWith('.html') || file.endsWith('.css') || file.endsWith('.mjs') || file.endsWith('.cjs')) fs.copyFileSync(path.join(src, file), path.join(dest, file)); }); }; copyDir('src/agent', 'out/agent'); copyDir('src/windows/setup', 'out/windows/setup'); copyDir('src/windows/settings', 'out/windows/settings');"

author: Rodrigo Barraza
